mapper.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.type_name AS typeName, c.work_permit_level AS workPermitLevel, c.level_definition AS levelDefinition, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.item_type = 'RISK_CHECK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS riskCheckCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.item_type = 'ACCEPTANCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acceptanceCount, c.permit_valid_hours AS permitValidHours FROM work_permit_type_config c LEFT JOIN work_permit_associated_item i ON i.work_permit_type_id = c.id
AND c.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.typeName}, '%')
AND c.work_permit_level = #{param.workPermitLevel}
GROUP BY c.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.work_permit_level FROM work_permit_type_config c
AND c.work_permit_level IS NOT NULL AND c.work_permit_level != ''
AND c.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.typeName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.work_permit_level ASC

SELECT c.id, c.type_name AS typeName FROM work_permit_type_config c
AND c.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.typeName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC

SELECT i.id, i.work_permit_type_id AS workPermitTypeId, c.type_name AS typeName, c.work_permit_level AS workPermitLevel, i.item_name AS itemName, i.sort_no AS sortNo
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC, i.sort_no ASC, i.id ASC

SELECT i.id
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC, i.sort_no ASC, i.id ASC
